video_title: Dylan Harper and Julian Champagnie Training Camp Media Availability, October 6, 2026

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on team continuity and growth for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: I feel like we're going to make mistakes, but that's the part of the first preseason game.
quotes.quote: Just continuity with the team. Obviously the same team, but different years. Going through the ups and downs and honestly, I'm just getting ready to get back out there with the guys and just play our best for forward and playing hard. I feel like we're going to make mistakes, but that's the part of the first preseason game of the year for everyone.
quotes.social_post: Dylan Harper on the Spurs entering preseason with a focus on continuity: I am just getting ready to get back out there with the guys and just play our best for forward and playing hard.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on handling increased media attention and expectations
quotes.excerpt: Obviously it's not so you can hide from. People around are going to tell you.
quotes.quote: Obviously it's not so you can hide from. People around are going to tell you, the closest ones are going to tell you, your phone's going to tell you, but I was just focused on getting better and we all got the same goal and last year ended not how we wanted it to end. So my biggest thing was regardless of anything, just hard to have my best for forward going into this year.
quotes.social_post: Dylan Harper says he is blocking out the noise and media attention to focus on team goals: My biggest thing was regardless of anything, just hard to have my best for forward going into this year.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on physical conditioning during training camp
quotes.excerpt: I'm blessed to be out here and getting in shape really.
quotes.quote: I couldn't do no live contact training camp one. So I mean training camp two, I'm blessed to be out here and getting in shape really. I feel like I didn't have that opportunity to do last year getting up and down, getting the mental reps, the physical reps, but I mean now I feel good enough and I feel ready to go.
quotes.social_post: Dylan Harper says he is finally healthy for training camp after missing live contact last year: I am blessed to be out here and getting in shape really. I feel like I did not have that opportunity to do last year.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on the team's shift in mindset during the NBA Cup
quotes.excerpt: I think leading up to the NBA Cup, I think our stacking wins obviously we had people out.
quotes.quote: I think leading up to the NBA Cup, I think our stacking wins obviously we had people out in the NBA Cup. I was out a few games, Big, Fox, Steph, everyone. But I mean I feel like after the NBA Cup and after Christmas, everyone kind of understood that you know we were serious.
quotes.social_post: Dylan Harper reflects on the team's midseason turnaround last year: After the NBA Cup and after Christmas, everyone kind of understood that you know we were serious.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on his evolving role as a leader
quotes.excerpt: Having a voice, being a leader, that's the biggest thing.
quotes.quote: Having a voice, being a leader, that's the biggest thing. Just have my voice, making sure that I know everyone's spots as much as my spots and just knowing the whole nuance of the system and just for myself personally, just bring everything else to another level whether that's shooting the ball, IQ, defense, it's everything.
quotes.social_post: Dylan Harper on his evolving leadership role: Having a voice, being a leader, that is the biggest thing. Making sure that I know everyone's spots as much as my spots and just knowing the whole nuance of the system.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on Julian Champagnie's versatility and value to the team
quotes.excerpt: Julian is great. I feel like he's Swiss Army knife.
quotes.quote: Julian is great. I feel like he's Swiss Army knife. He gives you whatever you need and anytime his number is called, which is called a lot, he's going to deliver time and time again. So I mean we're blessed to have him here and I wouldn't want to play against him.
quotes.social_post: Dylan Harper praises teammate Julian Champagnie: Julian is great. I feel like he is a Swiss Army knife. He gives you whatever you need and anytime his number is called, he is going to deliver time and time again.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on the rookie karaoke competition
quotes.excerpt: Terrance and Kobe. Kobe was actually singing and I feel like Terrance was the best performer.
quotes.quote: Terrance and Kobe. Kobe was actually singing and I feel like Terrance was the best performer. But shout out to Leakin and JQ. I feel like the mic was a little messed up though, so you know, we'll have to do it again.
quotes.social_post: Julian Champagnie gives his take on the rookie karaoke competition: Terrance and Kobe. Kobe was actually singing and I feel like Terrance was the best performer.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on the importance of fan and community engagement
quotes.excerpt: I base a lot of my outside of basketball stuff on is just getting involved.
quotes.quote: I base a lot of my outside of basketball stuff on is just getting involved with the fans and the community. They're half the equation. Obviously we go out there and play, they pay for tickets and they show up to the game. So the least we could do is give them some type of experience. Obviously we can't get to all of them, but if we can get to some of them, that's what we're going to do.
quotes.social_post: Julian Champagnie on the importance of fan engagement: I base a lot of my outside of basketball stuff on is just getting involved with the fans and the community. They are half the equation.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on Tobias Harris's injury and team adjustments
quotes.excerpt: It's a game, how it goes. Obviously we need him healthy.
quotes.quote: It's a game, how it goes. Obviously we need him healthy. He's a big part of our team, new piece, big part. You know, so we'll have to just adjust to him not being here and then adjust to him getting back. But it's throughout the year, I'm sure that there will be more, like more days like that. So we'll just have to figure it out.
quotes.social_post: Julian Champagnie discusses Tobias Harris being sidelined: We need him healthy. He is a big part of our team, new piece, big part. We will have to just adjust to him not being here and then adjust to him getting back.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on building team chemistry during preseason
quotes.excerpt: Just build the continuity, continue to, you know, build the team chemistry.
quotes.quote: Just build the continuity, continue to, you know, build the team chemistry. Obviously we're returning a lot of the same guys from last year. We're just continue to build that and sharpen that and work on it.
quotes.social_post: Julian Champagnie on the Spurs' preseason focus: Just build the continuity, continue to build the team chemistry. Obviously we are returning a lot of the same guys from last year.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on the irrelevance of preseason starting lineups
quotes.excerpt: I don't think it matters. We could have this thing starting lineup all year.
quotes.quote: I don't think it matters. We could have this thing starting lineup all year or we could have five different ones. To me it doesn't matter. It's not my job to figure out who's starting, who's not starting. I think as players we're all focused on just one thing and that's getting back to where we were last year.
quotes.social_post: Julian Champagnie says he is not concerned about preseason starting lineups: I do not think it matters. We could have this thing starting lineup all year or we could have five different ones.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on expectations for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: I think Carter is going to be, you know, better than he was last year.
quotes.quote: I think Carter is going to be, you know, better than he was last year. I think that's the goal. Every year just get better, get better, get better. No one's ever going to, you know, go from rookie to Bron in a year, but I expect him to to definitely make his jump. He's putting a lot of work all summer. He looks really good in workouts, so I expect Carter to do Carter things.
quotes.social_post: Julian Champagnie expects a jump from teammate Carter this season: I expect him to definitely make his jump. He is putting a lot of work all summer. He looks really good in workouts.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on Dillon's confidence and development
quotes.excerpt: Dillon is just confident. I think that obviously he came in the league last year.
quotes.quote: Dillon is just confident. I think that obviously he came in the league last year, turned a lot of heads, extremely talented basketball player. And I think that he's going to continue to come out this year, do the same things, better and show more. So I think he's going to be really good this year too.
quotes.social_post: Julian Champagnie on Dillon's development: Dillon is just confident. I think that he is going to continue to come out this year, do the same things, better and show more.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on the team's turnaround last season
quotes.excerpt: I feel like we always had the potential to be a team last year.
quotes.quote: I feel like we always had the potential to be a team last year that was like, all right, well they could they could really do some if they figure it out. And I think that we lost the game in Charlotte in January and then I think after that we lost three games. So I think from that point on we went on a run. We went on a roll and we figured something out and I feel like from there on they were like, all right, well we got to pay attention to what's going on in San Antonio.
quotes.social_post: Julian Champagnie on when the Spurs realized they were a contender last season: We went on a run. We went on a roll and we figured something out and I feel like from there on they were like, all right, well we got to pay attention.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on how his role affects his preparation
quotes.excerpt: It changed my warm up and how I stay ready off the bench.
quotes.quote: It changed my warm up and how I stay ready off the bench. But my approach mentally is going to be the same, coming to game, do my job, help the team and be a leader and talk and all those good things. So it's kind of just taking what I was doing last year from a starting standpoint and implementing that right off the bench.
quotes.social_post: Julian Champagnie on adjusting to a bench role: It changed my warm up and how I stay ready off the bench. But my approach mentally is going to be the same, coming to game, do my job, help the team and be a leader.
